name: ESO 174-1 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 174-1, a highly irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: eso1741-hubble
story: A bright cloud of stars and a faint, meandering tendril of gas and dust make up this highly irregular galaxy. Hubble visited it in an effort to resolve the brightest stars of every known nearby galaxy.

claims.text: ESO 174-1 is a highly irregular galaxy
It consists of a bright cloud of stars and a faint, meandering tendril of gas and dust
The observations aim to resolve the brightest stars of every known nearby galaxy
Also catalogued as HIPASS J1348-53; a dwarf galaxy
